sections.title: Calculate true landed costs on imported goods
sections.body: Wholesale margins are tight. If you only track the supplier price, you are missing the full picture. Importing containers means paying for freight, insurance, customs duties, and local transport. Paper & Pen allows you to record these additional expenses and allocate them to your purchase orders. This gives you the actual landed cost per unit. When you know exactly what a product costs to get into your warehouse, you can set accurate selling prices and protect your profit margins. You can also track bulk units from the moment they leave the supplier until they arrive at your loading dock.

Allocate freight and customs expenses to shipments
Calculate accurate landed costs per unit

sections.title: Manage break-bulk units and custom price lists
sections.body: Distributors rarely buy and sell in the same unit of measure. You might purchase a pallet of goods, break it down into cartons, and sell those cartons to different retailers. Our inventory system helps you track these break-bulk conversions so your stock counts remain accurate. Furthermore, wholesale is built on relationships. Your best buyers expect preferential pricing. You can configure customer-specific price lists to ensure your sales team always quotes the correct negotiated rate. Generate professional quotations, sales orders, and delivery notes that reflect the exact units and prices agreed upon with each buyer.
items: Convert pallets to cartons for accurate tracking
Store negotiated price lists for key buyers
Generate accurate quotations and sales orders
Issue delivery notes for warehouse dispatch

sections.title: Control trade credit and issue monthly statements
sections.body: B2B distribution relies heavily on trade credit. Managing who owes you money, and how much, is critical for cash flow. Paper & Pen acts as your complete customer ledger. You can monitor outstanding balances to ensure buyers do not exceed their agreed credit limits. At the end of the month, instead of chasing individual invoices, you can generate a consolidated monthly statement. Send this statement directly to your customer's accounting department via email or a WhatsApp link. If items are returned, you can easily issue credit notes to keep their account balance perfectly accurate.

Generate consolidated monthly statements for B2B buyers
Send statements instantly via email or WhatsApp
Issue credit notes for returned or damaged goods

faqs.q: Can I manage different price lists for different wholesale customers?
faqs.a: Yes. Wholesale businesses often negotiate specific rates with their largest distributors or retail partners. You can set up customer-specific pricing in Paper & Pen. When you create a quotation or a sales order for a particular buyer, the system will reflect their agreed price list. This prevents billing errors and ensures your sales staff always apply the correct margins without having to check a separate spreadsheet.

faqs.q: How does the software handle landed costs for imported containers?
faqs.a: When you import goods, the supplier invoice is only part of the expense. You also pay for shipping, insurance, and customs clearance. Paper & Pen allows you to record these additional expenses and associate them with your purchase orders. By factoring in these costs, the system calculates the true landed cost of your inventory. This ensures your profit and loss reports reflect reality and helps you price your goods correctly.

faqs.q: Can I generate consolidated monthly statements for my buyers?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Most B2B customers prefer to pay a single monthly statement rather than settling dozens of individual delivery invoices. You can generate a comprehensive customer ledger that lists all sales, payments, and credit notes for the period. This consolidated statement can be shared directly with your client via a WhatsApp link or email, making it easier for their accounts department to process your payment.

faqs.q: Does Paper & Pen support barcode scanning or third-party warehouse integrations?
faqs.a: No. Paper & Pen focuses on core cloud ERP, invoicing, and accounting functions. We do not offer third-party app integrations, automated warehouse robotics, or native barcode scanning modules. You can manually enter stock movements, track bulk and break-bulk units, and monitor stock ageing through our standard inventory reports. If you require advanced warehouse management systems with barcode scanners, our software might not be the right fit.
